name: TOTP Recovery Code Sign-In Rejected
summary: Rejects an invalid, already consumed, or otherwise unusable TOTP recovery code without establishing an authenticated application session.

guards.expression: the submitted recovery code is not accepted for the identified durable identity

sourceReferences.note: ConsumeRecoveryCodeAsync returns rejected results for missing, invalid, unavailable or already consumed recovery codes without authenticating the user.
Rejected recovery-code sign-in remains on the recovery-code entry surface and exposes no account or secret-state details.
